name: MIU
source:
"But I think there was something important."

Summer has not quite left, but an autumn breeze is already finding its way in.

On a walk with no destination, you meet an eccentric girl carefully unwrapping a piece of candy.

She cannot remember her name or why she came here, yet she insists she has been waiting for you. When you ask what she needs, she thinks for a while and offers you a lemon candy.

Then she starts following you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5324860/MIU/]Steam[/url]]
